decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (see attached schdule) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Details in respect of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the relevant work is begun. The relevant work shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
A) Drawings at 1:5 with details of glazing bars at 1:1 of the proposed new windows.
B) Details of the proposed new staircases, and proposed fixings to the tower.
C) Detailed drawings of the links between the listed building and the new structures to include any proposed fixings to the listed structure.
D) Landscaping details for the entrance courtyard to include samples of proposed materials.
E) Details of internal works of fitting out the area within the listed structure to include any proposed wall and floor coverings.

Condition : 4 - A schedule of repair for the listed church and the boundary wall shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the relevant work is begun. The relevant work shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to method used and to colour textile and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by condition attached to this consent.

Condition : 6 - All existing internal features, including plaster work, ironwork, memorial plaques, doors, windows, staircases, staircase balustrade and other woodwork, shall remain undisturbed in their existing position, and shall be fully protected during the course of works on site unless expressly specified in the approved drawings.

Condition : 7 - No new plumbing, pipes, soil stacks, flues, vents grilles, security alarms or ductwork shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the drawings hereby approved.

Condition : 8 - Samples of all proposed materials for the new buildings must be
submitted to and approved in writing to the Local Planning Authority
before the relevant work is begun. The relevant work shall be carried
out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Change of use and external and internal alterations to the listed building at St Lawrence's Church to Health and Fitness use (D2 use) (As amended)
